notes.title: Added chapter selection function - The Method of Hiding a Body
notes.content:
1. This game has now added chapter selection function, players can now select chapters in the main interface to play.
2. Added the option to adjust the Camera Shake Amplitude in the game Settings menu.
3. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: 2024/6/1 Description of the update V 2.02
notes.content:
1. Players can now choose to return to the save point directly from the Settings menu.
2. Added some guidance.
3. Fixed some translation issues.
4. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: 2024/5/28 Updated description
notes.content:
1. Cut a lengthy level flow in half
2. Fixed a bug where running before climbing the ladder would cause players to shift after climbing the ladder
3. Fixed some lighting bugs.

notes.title: Add checkpoint (Save point) function Version 2.00
notes.content:
1. The game has now added a checkpoint function, when the player plays a non-final ending, he can restart from the previous checkpoint, instead of starting the whole round again.
2. A dimly-lit scene adds brightness
3. Camera's shaking amplitude is changed to 70%
4. Added more guidance.
5. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Subsequent update notice-checkpoint ( save point)
notes.content: After receiving feedback from players, we decided to make a checkpoint function, which is under development to make it easier for players to play all endings faster.
